Package com.github.crittscott.somegoogly.gametest

Class FramedEyeGameTestsLogic

java.lang.Object
com.github.crittscott.somegoogly.gametest.FramedEyeGameTestsLogic
public final class FramedEyeGameTestsLogic extends Object
Drives the mounted eye simulation without a client renderer. Actual frame mounting, render-context isolation, lighting, pause, and unloading require the in-game checks in docs/framed-eyes-testing.md.

  • Method Details

    • framedEyeFiltersItems

      public static void framedEyeFiltersItems(net.minecraft.gametest.framework.GameTestHelper helper)
      Empty slots, Slimy Eyes, and ordinary items are ineligible. In game: replace a framed Googly Eye with a Slimy Eye, a diamond, and nothing; only the Googly Eye has a simulated pupil.

    • framedEyeFollowsMountedGravity

      public static void framedEyeFollowsMountedGravity(net.minecraft.gametest.framework.GameTestHelper helper)
      Mounted pupils follow supplied gravity instead of always falling along the item's own down. In game: right-click a wall-mounted eye to rotate it; its pupil still falls toward the ground.

    • framedEyeHandlesShortIntervalsAndTimeJumps

      public static void framedEyeHandlesShortIntervalsAndTimeJumps(net.minecraft.gametest.framework.GameTestHelper helper)
      Short ambient intervals cannot overlap expressions; a time jump reconstructs the current slot. In game: set ambient min/max to their minimum and pool to blink; framed eyes keep blinking cleanly.

    • framedEyeHonorsAmbientSettings

      public static void framedEyeHonorsAmbientSettings(net.minecraft.gametest.framework.GameTestHelper helper)
      Ambient-off, empty, and partner-only pools suppress expressions, including one already active when settings change. In game: reload each setting and observe that the framed eye stops expressing.

    • framedEyePlaysSingleEyeExpressions

      public static void framedEyePlaysSingleEyeExpressions(net.minecraft.gametest.framework.GameTestHelper helper)
      Removing cross-eye from a mixed pool still leaves lone-eye expressions available. In game: use ambient pool [cross_eye, blink]; the framed eye winks but never tries to cross toward another eye.

    • framedEyeReconstructsExpressions

      public static void framedEyeReconstructsExpressions(net.minecraft.gametest.framework.GameTestHelper helper)
      A newly created tracker joins a running expression with identical age and seeded parameters. In game: two players view one frame, with the second arriving mid-expression; both see its same phase.

    • framedEyeReleasesExpressionOverlays

      public static void framedEyeReleasesExpressionOverlays(net.minecraft.gametest.framework.GameTestHelper helper)
      Expressions finish, leaving neutral overlays between slots. In game: restrict ambient pool to blink and watch the frame reopen fully before its next wink.

    • framedEyeUsesIndependentSchedules

      public static void framedEyeUsesIndependentSchedules(net.minecraft.gametest.framework.GameTestHelper helper)
      Frames use independent UUID schedules. In game: fill several neighboring frames with copies of one eye; they express independently even though their displayed items match.

    • framedHeadAllowsPairedExpressions

      public static void framedHeadAllowsPairedExpressions(net.minecraft.gametest.framework.GameTestHelper helper)
      Two head pupils can cross; the same pool is suppressed for a lone loose eye. In game: set the ambient pool to cross_eye and frame an eyed skull beside a Googly Eye; only the skull crosses.

    • framedHeadInvalidatesChangedItems

      public static void framedHeadInvalidatesChangedItems(net.minecraft.gametest.framework.GameTestHelper helper)
      Species, variant, and appearance changes invalidate a head tracker; plain heads have no tracker. In game: replace an eyed framed head with another species, another eye color/glow, then a plain head and a loose eye. No former head layout or expression remains attached to the new contents.

    • framedHeadReconstructsExpressions

      public static void framedHeadReconstructsExpressions(net.minecraft.gametest.framework.GameTestHelper helper)
      Newly arriving viewers reconstruct a head's expression and blink participation. In game: join another player's framed-head display mid-blink; the same eyes blink at the same expression age.

    • framedHeadUsesConfiguredLayout

      public static void framedHeadUsesConfiguredLayout(net.minecraft.gametest.framework.GameTestHelper helper)
      Eyed heads carry their mob's configured head parts and pupil arrays, including mounted gravity. In game: frame an eyed skeleton skull and a supported Heads-mod head; their eyes retain their normal positions, colors, and sizes while their pupils animate.
